_readme: FUT Champions Weekend League reward settings (pack-odds-2026-09 PLAN.md 5.2). The reward ranks themselves are tables since migration 126,
edited in the operator panel (Modes, Champions); a fresh database is seeded from rewards/champions.json.
Loaded at server start and validated strictly (an invalid file stops the server). The win ranks must cover 0 to seasons.json weekendLeague.maxMatches.
Top bands depend on leaderboard position (ordered by wins, then Skill Rating) and, from Weekend League minWinsForTopFromEvent, need minWinsForTop wins
(owner, 2026-10-05: 6 from 2962, 9-12 Oct 2026; 2961 is not changed retroactively); a club in a Top place with fewer wins takes the rank its wins earn,
and its place shows no Top position.
The six Top bands' places follow seasons.json weekendLeague.topX (the Top players number) and never change with the number of players (owner, 2026-10-03: band sizing removed, migration 128).
Paid 17:00 UK time on the Monday the Weekend League ends (seasons.json rewardHourUk) to players with minMatchesToRank matches.
FUT Champions Points by finish are retail's; they are capped at fcPointsCap in total (retail: any points above 2,000 are lost).
